ornament.tutorial_mod.equip: Curios: equip in a Stellar Ornament slot. Without Curios, hold in offhand.
ornament.tutorial_mod.limit: Up to 3 unique ornaments; inventory, main hand and cosmetic slots do not activate effects.
ornament.tutorial_mod.starfall_amulet.de: Gain +10% star energy, additive with talents. Still requires a full stellar set; capacity unchanged.
ornament.tutorial_mod.orbit_ring.desc: +5% additive astral sword damage; snapshotted at wave launch.
ornament.tutorial_mod.wing_brooch.desc: Take 20% less fall damage. No flight or duplicate stacking.
ornament.tutorial_mod.crescent_earring.d: Grants night vision; fades within 11s after removal. Never removes other night vision sources.
ornament.tutorial_mod.dawn_crown.desc: +2 max health (1 heart); removed on unequip.
ornament.tutorial_mod.meteor_pendant.des: Monster kills have a 20% chance to repair 2 main-hand durability. One attempt/10s; skips Mending by default.
ornament.tutorial_mod.astral_compass.des: +10% mining speed for ores. No extra drops or x-ray.
ornament.tutorial_mod.astral_badge.desc: +0.05 knockback resistance; duplicates do not stack.
At hunger 16+, after 5s out of combat, heal 1 HP every 10s. No lethal-damage immunity.
message.tutorial_mod.shield_already_full: Energy shield is already full; G does not restore the guardian barrier
message.tutorial_mod.skill_requires_set: A matching full four-piece stellar set is required
message.tutorial_mod.movement_blocked: Movement blocked by blocks, liquid or a boundary. Aim at open space; no energy spent
talent.tutorial_mod.title: Stellar Talents · Constellations
talent.tutorial_mod.cost: Reset: %s XP levels + %s star ingots; free in Creative
talent.tutorial_mod.reset_fail: Reset requires %s XP levels and %s star ingots.
talent.tutorial_mod.earned: Earned %s stellar talent points! Press O (rebindable).
talent.tutorial_mod.prerequisite: 1 point per rank, max 3. Subsequent nodes require rank 2 in the previous node.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.0: With the astral sword: +4% additive damage per rank.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.1: +3% additive attack speed per rank while holding the astral sword.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.2: Heal for 0.5% actual monster-hit damage per rank; shared with Star Leech, once/second, up to 2 HP.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.3: With sword and full energy: +8% additive damage per rank; snapshotted when a wave launches.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.4: Matching full stellar set: +4 armor per rank.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.5: Matching full set: +10 max health per rank; removed on unequip.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.6: Matching full set: +1% additive damage immunity per rank.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.7: Full set: each second, spend 2 energy per rank to restore 1 shield per rank, capped.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.8: +10% energy gained per rank, rounded up; still requires a full set, capacity capped.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.9: Full set: restore 1 base energy per rank every 5 seconds; benefits from resonance.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.10: Full set: +3% additive movement speed per rank.
talent.tutorial_mod.desc.11: Full set: every 10s, each damaged stellar item costs 1 energy to repair 1 durability per rank; no Mending stacking by default.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.star_edge.desc: Astral sword only. +8% additive damage per level, snapshotted at wave launch.
Astral sword only. +1 energy per level on monster hits, once per second; requires a full set.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.star_leech.desc: Astral sword only. Heal 1% actual monster-hit damage per level; shared talent cap of 2 HP once/second.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.star_ward.desc: Stellar chestplate only. +1% additive damage immunity per level.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.star_stride.des: Stellar boots only. +3% additive movement speed per level.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.star_mending.de: Stellar chestplate only. Full set: repair damaged stellar equipment every 10s, 1 durability/level, 1 energy/item. No Mending stacking by default.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.super_sharpness: Adds 20 percent damage per level, additive with Ultimate Sharpness and armor damage bonuses. Works with melee and astral slashes.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.ultimate_sharpn: Adds 50 percent damage per level, additive with Super Sharpness and armor damage bonuses. Works with melee and astral slashes.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.supreme_sharpne: Independent damage multiplier: 2 raised to the enchantment level. Levels I/II/III multiply damage by 2/4/8.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.momentum.desc: At 50/100/150 consecutive hits, independently multiplies damage by 1.5/2/2.5. The combo resets after a period without hits.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.critical_strike: Adds 10 percentage points of critical chance per level, capped at 100 percent. Base critical damage is double. Works with melee and astral slashes.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.lethal_strike.d: Adds 0.2 to the critical damage multiplier per level. Level III increases the base multiplier from 2 to 2.6; does not add critical chance.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.gale.desc: Adds 0.2 attack speed per level as a flat bonus while held in the main hand.
enchantment.tutorial_mod.godspeed.desc: Adds 50 percent base attack speed per level, additive with other base-percentage speed bonuses while held in the main hand.
